request.style: English, Southern gospel quartet ballad, a smooth lead voice with the tenor floating high and the bass answering low, gospel piano and steel guitar, slow and sweet, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Do not let your hearts be troubled
You believe in God, believe in me
In my Father's house are many rooms
If it were not so, would I have told you

[Chorus]
There's a room prepared for me
In my Father's house up yonder
I will go and he will come again
And take me home to be with him

[Verse]
I go to prepare a place for you
And if I go, I'll come again
And take you to myself, that where I am
There you may be also, my friend

[Chorus]
There's a room prepared for me
In my Father's house up yonder
I will go and he will come again
And take me home to be with him
